This scene:
孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。他们搬家不是因为孟子玩得太多，而是因为妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 孟子小的时候：better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜：在墓地玩，在Place V.; 装着祭拜的样子

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 喜欢玩在墓地里：喜欢在墓地里玩，A location phrase should come before the verb it modifies; here the playing happens in the cemetery. [rule: none]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 装祭拜：装作祭拜，装作 means “pretend to do something” and must be followed by the action being pretended. [rule: none]
3. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 跟妈妈搬家：跟妈妈搬家了，This is one completed move at a specific time in the past, so it needs 了 to mark completion. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: 地点短语应放在动作“玩”前面。
“装”不能直接带“祭拜”，要用“装作”表达假装进行该动作。
这里叙述五岁时一次已经完成的搬家事件，句末需要“了”。
